title: Add RAG agent examples, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Maya Thompson
description: Motivation: surface realistic RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts in the docs and examples repo so developers can get started faster and validate tool integrations. This PR adds three new RAG agent quickstarts (FAQ bot, internal KB assistant, sales playbook), multiple tool-calling examples (search, calendar, ticketing), a set of opinionated RAG templates with recommended prompt/scan/embedding configuration, and docs site navigation updates. Changes include examples with runnable Docker and devcontainer configurations, unit/integration tests for the examples harness, and a docs site landing page + sidebar entries. Checklist: - Add RAG templates and agent examples - Add tool-calling quickstarts and example tool adapters - Add docs site pages and navigation - Include CI tests for examples - Update release notes and changelog Summary of changes: added docs/rag/quickstarts/* (3 new guides), added examples/rag/agents/* (3 runnable examples), added examples/tools/* (3 tool adapters: search, calendar, ticketing), updated redwood-docs/site/content/guides/rag-overview.md, updated redwood-docs/site/config/sidebar.yaml, added tests/examples/test_rag_agents.py and CI integration job, small API shim in redwood-examples to demonstrate call patterns. Rationale: many customers and community contributors request end-to-end templates that combine retrieval, tool calling, and structured outputs; this PR consolidates those patterns and provides vetted defaults for prompt templates, chunking, and embedding configs. Backwards compatibility: docs-only/examples-only; no runtime breaking changes. Related Linear/Jira: ENG-7890 DOCS-342 SUP-1123. Merge method: squash.
